notes: Run only in an isolated Intelligence worktree and respect the current projector-only product boundary.
The benchmark must not add a TUI when the repository excludes one or modify remote state.
setupQuestions: Which existing human-facing terminal state is in product scope and safe to refine locally?

scenarios.title: Terminal UI contract preservation
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether a terminal-interface decision preserves product scope, machine-facing CLI contracts, degraded modes, and cleanup behavior.
scenarios.userInput: Use Terminal UI Design to audit one existing human-facing terminal flow in this isolated Intelligence worktree. Preserve its projector-only product scope, command contracts, no-color and redirected-output behavior, and terminal cleanup. If the current product excludes a TUI, record that boundary and make no UI change. Do not push, publish, open or update a pull request, or otherwise modify remote state.
successChecklist: The run names the current terminal stack, explicit product scope, and reachable states.
No TUI or UI dependency is added when the product boundary excludes it.
Focused proof covers machine-readable output and relevant degraded or cleanup behavior.
